Moog is a performance culture that empowers people to achieve great things. Our people enjoy solving interesting technical challenges in a culture where everyone trusts each other to do the right thing. For you, working with us can mean deeper job satisfaction, better rewards, and a great quality of life inside and outside of work.

 
 Job Title :
NX CAM Software Development Engineer 
 Reporting To: 
Head, IT Section 
 Work Schedule: 
Onsite – Buffalo, NY Moog is a performance culture that empowers people to achieve great things. Our people enjoy solving interesting technical challenges in a culture where everyone trusts each other to do the right thing. For you, working with us can mean deeper job satisfaction, better rewards, and a great quality of life inside and outside of work.  
    
 Our Corporate IT Group is looking for an NX CAM Software Development Engineer to join them. You will be the technical resource for internal development (coding) of post-processors for NX and lead post-related training or procurement efforts. This role is pivotal in supporting our growing manufacturing operations for all Moog business units across our global footprint.   
     
 This role is full-time on-site in our East Aurora, NY office requiring domestic and international travel, up to 25%.   
 This role requires access to data subject to U.S. government citizenship restrictions as well. 
 
 To be considered for the NX CAM Software Development Engineer role, here’s what you’ll typically need to bring with you:   
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering discipline, or related field or Equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree  
 Proven aptitude and experience in the development of software solutions  
 Experience with coding languages at least 2 of the following:  TCL, NX Open, Python, G-Code ISO 6983 … or similar  
 Experience using version control software, i.e Git, Subversion, or similar  
 Helpful but not required, experience using Post Builder/Post Configurator to create and maintain NX post processors  
 Helpful but not required, experience with NX CAD and/or Siemens Teamcenter   
 Excellent written and oral communication skills; demonstrated competence communicating with all levels of the organization and providing exceptional customer service 
 
 As the NX CAM Software Development Engineer, you will:   
 Field requests from users across Moog for post development, and deliver functioning software within project timelines  
 Contribute to post developments routed through Enterprise IT, responsible for developing service roadmaps, reporting, managing customer demand, and implementing continuous improvement efforts to constantly evolve the service  
 Support enterprise IT processes for the requisition and delivery of post processors, setting and enforcing technical standards regarding things like integration methods or code structure  
 Develop and or facilitate training for other engineering resources which develop posts  
 Remain engaged in supporting internal customers through the lifecycle of post development, procurement, delivery, and sustainment  
 Support users with NX CAM questions, issues, and help drive enterprise CAM configurations  
 Collaborate as part of the Enterprise IT Applications organization, leveraging relationships with peer leaders to drive improvement of IT services across the organization  
 Contribute to the development and growth of capabilities in the organization to support this workstream long term
 
 How We Care for You: 
 Financial Rewards: great compensation package, annual profit sharing, matching 401k, and the ability to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts
 Work/Life Balance: Flexible paid time off, holidays and parental leave program, relocation assistance.
 Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
 Professional Skills Development: Tuition Assistance, mentorship and coaching opportunities, leadership development and other personal growth programs
 Diverse and Inclusive Workplace: Employee Resource Groups, cultural events, and celebrations. 

 
 
 Salary Range Transparency: 
Buffalo, NY $85,000.00–$135,000.00 Annually
 Salary Range Disclaimer 
 The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Moog salary range for this position in the given work location. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range(s) listed is just one component of Moog's total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, employee stock purchase plan, an open paid time off policy, and many region-specific benefits. 

 This position requires access to U.S. export-controlled information.

 Moog offers an inclusive workplace, and, as such, affirms the right of every person to participate in all aspects of employment based on merit without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic. If you are interested in applying for employment and need special assistance or an accommodation to apply for a posted position, contact our Human Resources department via phone at 844-367-5787. 

 No unsolicited agency submittals please. Agency partners must be invited to participate in a search by our Talent Acquisition Team and have signed terms in place prior to any submittal. Absent compliance with these pre-conditions resumes submitted directly to any Moog Inc. employee or affiliate will not qualify for fee payment, and therefore become the property of Moog Inc.
